steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Today's masquerade is another huge success!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Did you hear how loud they were cheering for the encore? I bet that one kid was a total Nyamuchi fan!

spans.text: Did you hear how loud they were cheering for the encore? I bet that one kid was a

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Like, her eyes were glittering like crazy when I came on stage! Man, that makes me happy.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: We should add a little more fan interaction to our next show, whaddaya say?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: It's one thing to think of ways to increase appeal, Yūtenji-san, but do not lose sight of Ave{@nbs}Mujica's worldview.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Bleeeh... What, you afraid I'll steal the whole audience away?

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: My fans are just here to soak up Ave{@nbs}Mujica's masquerades. Why not hook them on Mujica itself?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Your very posture is a part of the performance. We must not let our guards down until the curtains have truly fallen.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: It is our mission to see our guests enraptured in this masquerade.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: We must therefore present a convincing image—

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Alright, alright.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Saaay, Muuko, didn't you get the biggest cheers when you took the stage?

spans.text: get the biggest cheers when you took the stage?

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: You were happy, weren't you? You wanted even more fans, didn't you? Be honest.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: I... don't...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Stop trying to incite Mutsumi, please.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Haha... come on, no arguing...

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: I just think everyone's looking forward to the next performance—

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: We've got so many people on our side right now. Here's our chance to repay them by giving our all.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Saki-chan's doing her best to compose the new song. The light in the loft's been on so late these past few days...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Be assured that in the face of all your efforts, I can hardly rest on my own laurels.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Saki-chan...

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Sakiko, real talk. Remember to chill out a little.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: We all get what you're putting into this, Saki-chan. I'll make sure the lyrics are worthy of the new song.

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: Togawa-san played me a sample before the show. It's a good song.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Well, if I had to say, maybe... the tempo could be a tiny bit slower?

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Huh?! You all heard it already? When??

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Just before the show today. I think you weren't in the dressing room?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I wanted to get the opinions of everyone, but time was short, so I simply played it for those present.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Nyamu made me go on her livestream as a guest... I didn't get to hear it.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Guh...!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Yūtenji, didn't I say not to—

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: L-Look, the light's turning green! We can talk about this on the other side!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: *sigh* What a headache...

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: ...It's so wonderful.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Hm? What's this all of a sudden?

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: I was touched by what you were saying just now.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Even after all we went through, even though we've fought, the five of us are still together as a band... It's so wonderful.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: I've never asked them, but I'm sure everyone thinks that way... I know I do.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: As for me, I'm so glad you can put your trust in me this way, Saki-chan.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: I could offer my whole life to Mujica, I really could!
Sakiko follows Uika's gaze. A group of girls are merrily crossing the road.
They are unburdened, free of cares, as if this were all a beautiful fairy tale.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Though none say it out loud, they all owe a debt of gratitude to their Saki-chan. In Nyamu's own words, Mujica made her dreams come true.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: A dream...

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: It's like how everything used to be... It's almost like we're dreaming.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Huh...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...Dreaming?

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Come on, you two, let's not do this here...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Are you telling me to cast aside our identity as a band?!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Well, band or not, I don't care.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: I mean, is there any reason we have to be a band for this?

spans.text: I mean, is there any reason we have to be a

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: What in the world are—

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Besides, I don't hear Muuko complaining. Hell, she's the one who said 'it won't last' on TV.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Never mind being a band, I don't think she'd lose too much sleep over leaving Mujica.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: That was—

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: ...I won't let Mujica disband.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Where'd you get that from? I didn't say anything about disbanding.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: A member leaving is the same as us disbanding. And it's a betrayal of our fans' support.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: And what I'm saying is, we've already betrayed it just now. Besides, you talk a big show for someone too damn busy to show up to practice, don't you?

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: That's just irresponsible, isn't it?

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: How could you...!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: If we're dealing in responsibility here, then I'd like to say you're the one who needs more practice, Yūtenji-san!

spans.text: here, then I'd like to say you're the one who needs more practice, Yūtenji-san!

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: I've never felt Yūtenji-san to be lacking in practice. Togawa-san, aren't you the one not paying attention to your band members here?
Uika increases her pace to catch up with the other members who have gone ahead, but Sakiko lags dazedly behind the crowd.
She stares blankly at the flashing signal. Her legs feel as though they've been filled with lead. She can't put a single step forward.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Hey! What are you standing there for?

steps.name: Umiri Yahata
steps.text: Did you leave something behind?

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: ...Saki. The light's turning red.

steps.name: Uika Misumi
steps.text: Saki-chan?

a.text: 'You should go back, Saki-chan. Better you never saw me again...'

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: We're not gonna wait for you if you don't keep up!
The traffic signal beeps its urgent warning. Sakiko tries to follow, but the light has turned red.
Car after car flies past. Sakiko lifts the wind-frayed tips of her hair. The traffic light highlights her face in silhouette.
Something falls into her palm.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Is this... rain?
Raindrops plummet from the sky, faster, heavier.
A torrent of memories comes rushing back—
The sound around her amplifies. The noise of the crowd and the horns of cars batter her eardrums.
Rain soaks into her clothes, becoming one with her tears.
Her sorrow and helplessness cannot be told, yet the way she cries towards the sky tells all.
Melancholy and despair sweep over her, and her vision grows blurry along with the memories.
Clank, clunk.
Sakiko? Sakiko!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Mm... hmm?
Time to get up, sleepyhead! It's a beautiful day.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: M... Miss Vigna? Am I dreaming...?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Excuse me, don't pinch my face!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: I'm not pinching that hard. Just doing the check for you.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: (Pinches own face) See? Not that bad.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You're not the one getting face-pinched without warning first thing in the morning!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Alright, alright, I'll lay off. Go get yourself ready; I'll wait for you outside.
She presses her ear against the cool wall. The whir of the mobility layer transmits through the structure of the landship.
Clank, clunk.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: So that was the sound of the mobility layer...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: What was that strange scene... and those people?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: So let me get this straight—you dreamt about a group of people you never met?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...Correct. The surroundings were completely unfamiliar too.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Unfamiliar vehicles, unfamiliar buildings, unfamiliar clothing...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Could it be a movie?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Oh, sometimes I watch documentaries before I go to bed, and then I dream about being in those places...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: But I haven't experienced anything close to this before...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Maybe you're just tired?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Whislash was telling me how you always train until way late. Apparently you don't even stop until she tells you to.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: And I think I saw your name on the Engineering Department's volunteers list...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: You're still pretty new here. You've got plenty of time and plenty of chances to adjust.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Maybe take a little vacation if you're feeling tired? Give yourself a break.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I'm fine, I can deal with it...

steps.name: Flustered Operator
steps.text: M-Miss Sakiko! A hand, please!

steps.name: Flustered Operator
steps.text: The Medical Department just got a bunch of patients that we need to arrange accommodations for...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: That's not meant to be Sakiko's job, is it?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Besides, isn't this a little complicated for a rookie to handle?

steps.name: Flustered Operator
steps.text: S-Sorry, but the person in charge wanted Miss Sakiko specifically...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Where are we going? Show me the way.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I've helped them out before. I'm well-acquainted with the entire workflow.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: If they're short of hands, I will most certainly lend mine.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Hey...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Vigna, I'll see you at the usual place!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Wait, hold—!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Jeez. I don't remember her learning any of that...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Fifty-three, fifty-four, fifty-five... fifty-six...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Almost done with the stuff on this shelf. It's good to go once it's packed.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Mrngh... It's been an hour. Where's Sakiko?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: There you are, Sakiko!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I duly apologize, I ended up spending more time on the patients than anticipated...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: No big. Y'know... you've only been on Rhodes a few months, right? 'Cause it feels to me like you've been a part of the place forever.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Really? It does?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Everyone's like yeah, leave it to Sakiko, she'll do a good job. People are counting on you without realizing it.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Heck, even I am. I have to keep reminding myself you're a rookie, and I can't put too much on your plate.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: I saw you sign up for the music club, but you've never gotten to attend any of our meetings...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Vigna, it's alright.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I joined Rhodes Island because I wanted to help people fight Oripathy.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Oripathy... If I recall, that's how your mom died, isn't it?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Before she did, I was under the naive belief that I could live my days without worry or care.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...But Terra put the lie to that beauty.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I watched Mother struggle against her illness until it finally took her. I've seen so much since joining Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Sufferings plague these lands as we speak, and I still have to learn.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Yeah, I think I understand where you're coming from...
Are you done on your side, Vigna?
The caravan's ready. We're just waiting on you and your batch of the supplies.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Oh, shoot! I'm on it!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: What are you packaging these supplies for? An emergency shipment?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: There's a town nearby that needs food and medicine urgently. The route's not safe. Need us to escort.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I'll come with you. There must be something I can help with.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: No, you...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Alright, alright...

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Iris. There's no need to be so nervous, and certainly no need to blame yourself.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: ...I should have noticed earlier.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Even the best of us let things slip through the cracks. Besides, you only correspond through letters. It's natural you wouldn't notice.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: But... but she...!

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: You're hyperventilating again... come now, take a deep breath. Relax.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: I gave Vigna a push just now. We'll be on our way soon.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: ...We have to make it there before dark.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: We will.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: We know what to do when we see her, we hashed it all out. Just follow that, and everything will be fine.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Sorry we're late!

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: That's alright—

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Not a moment too soon—driver, take us away!
The engine rumbles, and the vehicle accelerates through the passage.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Phew. I hope we still make it in time—

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Oh, we were in such a hurry, I almost forgot! Lemme introduce you girls.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: This is Sakiko, our new trainee operator. She's from Victoria, just like you guys, and she's helping me out with logistics work right now.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Iris and Bena here are... uh... how do I put it...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Oh, yeah! 'Fairies!'

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Er. Fairies?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Now now, Vigna, we can introduce ourselves. We've done this song and dance more times than we can count.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: So, Miss Sakiko of Victoria, I assume you know fairytales of the Castle of Dreams?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I read some in storybooks when I was little.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Do you believe they're real?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Well... I did pester Mother about them plenty, at that age.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: So you don't believe in them now.

spans.text: So you don't believe in them

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Well, I don't mean that exactly—

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: But every fairytale is true, you know.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: 'Deep in the forests of Victoria, there towers the Castle of Dreams, where fairies make their home and bring sweet dreams to every child.'

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Does it really exist?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Say, you're not all grown-up yet, right, Sakiko? Maybe those weird dreams of yours have something to do with the fairies.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Fairies would never barge into children's dreams without permission. It's not the done thing.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Dreams are the reflection of oneself, and the formation of thought. Doubly so for a child whose mind is still delicate.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Some dreams can change a child's entire life.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: We bring sweet dreams to children, yes, but first we gain their permission. Then, we consider very carefully what the stuff of said dreams will be, and when exactly to bring them.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I have to say, the dreams I've been having are a far cry from 'sweet'... 'bewildering' is the more appropriate word.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: You can always have Iris help you interpret your dreams. Once she's a little less busy.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Iris can? Actually, when was the last time either of you had time off?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Sakiko never got to meet you two 'cause you spent so little time at Rhodes in the first place.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Iris is the Master of the Castle of Dreams. There's a lot that demands her personal attention.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: *sigh* It's a shame I'm not cut out for dreamspinning myself, else I could lighten some of her load.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: (Mutters) Though there are others with the talent to spin dreams... but that 'child' is much too dangerous.

spans.text: others with the talent to spin dreams... but that 'child' is much too dangerous.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: So is that the order of business this time as well? Bringing sweet dreams to children?

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Yes, and no...

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Iris, can I tell her?

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: ...I'll tell her myself.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: One year ago, I happened across a storybook that utterly captivated me.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: I wrote to the address on the title page, and became pen pals with the author. Through letters, we exchanged fairytale interpretations and imaginations with one another.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: But more recently, her replies began to dwindle. It had been a while since I'd seen her message, too.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: Then two days ago, I got a letter from her. And inside was a brand new story she had written.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: The protagonist girl has a quick-tempered father, and she finds herself isolated among children her own age...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: It was the complete opposite of all her previous stories, and she told me... this was what her life was really like.

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: In closing, on the cusp of adulthood, she mentioned her birthday—the date is... tomorrow.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: She wasn't even an adult yet?! Jeez...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: And the single line at the end of the letter keeps haunting me...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: She said she didn't want to grow up...
'This will be my final letter.'

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...Less than twelve hours until the day turns over.

steps.name: Bena
steps.text: Yes. That's why Iris is in such a rush. We must hurry to the town, and find—

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: What was that?!

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: We just burst a tire. The roads here are shot...

steps.name: Iris
steps.text: ...What?!
Under the blazing sun, waves of scorching heat sink through the skin.
This is going to be a very long wait.
